notes.text:
This update for libexif fixes the following issues

- CVE-2026-40385: Fixed information disclosure and crashes via integer overflow in Nikon MakerNote 
  handling (bsc#1262000)
- CVE-2026-40386: Fixed denial of service and information disclosure via integer underflow in MakerNote 
  decoding (bsc#1262001)
- CVE-2026-32775: Fixed Buffer overwrite via integer underflow in MakerNotes decoding (bsc#1259755)
